TOKEN_EXPIRED.explicacao: The Instagram account authorization expired or was revoked. Reconnect the account on the client page and reschedule the post.

MEDIA_TOO_LARGE.explicacao: Instagram rejected the file because of its size. Images: up to 8 MB. Videos: up to 250 MB. Adjust the media in the gallery and try again.

CAROUSEL_LIMIT.explicacao: Publishing through the API accepts at most 10 items per carousel. Remove items in the gallery and try again.

NO_MEDIA.explicacao: The post was scheduled without any image or video. Attach the media in the gallery and reschedule.

MEDIA_UNSUPPORTED.titulo: Instagram could not process the media
MEDIA_UNSUPPORTED.explicacao: The file has a format, aspect ratio or duration that Instagram does not accept. Check the media in the gallery and try again.

TRIAL_INELIGIBLE.explicacao: The post needs exactly one video, and the account must be professional, public and have 1,000+ followers. Adjust the post or the account, or turn off Trial reel, and try again.

CAPTION_TOO_LONG.explicacao: Instagram accepts at most 2,200 characters in the caption. Shorten the text in the gallery and try again.

COLLABORATOR_INVALID.explicacao: Check that the @ is correct and that the profile is public. Edit the collaborators and try again.

ACCOUNT_RESTRICTED.explicacao: Instagram restricted access to this account. Check the Instagram app for notices or restrictions before trying again.

CONTAINER_EXPIRED.explicacao: Instagram discards prepared posts that are not completed within 24 hours. Try again to start over.

RATE_LIMIT.explicacao: Instagram limits how many posts an account can publish through the API in 24 hours. Wait a bit and try again.

IG_TRANSIENT.explicacao: Instagram returned a temporary error. It usually works when you try again.

INTERNAL.explicacao: Something failed on our side; it is not a problem with the post or the account. Try again and, if it persists, contact support with the post details.

UNKNOWN.explicacao: Instagram returned an unrecognized error. Try again and, if it persists, contact support.

objects.title: The objects
objects.fluxoDefProcesses: one delivery cycle for a client: a kanban card
objects.fluxoDef: one delivery cycle for a client: the kanban card
objects.etapasDefProcesses: the phases of the workflow or individual post: only one is active at a time
objects.etapasDef: the phases of the workflow: only one is active at a time
objects.postsDef: the content itself, each with its own status
objects.individualDef: a post with its own stages and no workflow: also a kanban card
objects.modelo: A template is the reusable skeleton of a workflow. Editing it updates the open stages of the workflows that use it, but keeps what was adjusted in the workflow itself, such as a different deadline or assignee.

tracks.title: There are two separate tracks
tracks.body: Advancing the stage does not touch the post statuses, and changing a post status does not advance the stage. A workflow can be in “Scheduling” with everything still in Draft.
tracks.exception: Exception: when you complete an approval stage, you choose what happens to the posts: keep them, approve all, or send them back to Draft.
tracks.noFluxoProcesses: A post can also exist without a workflow: standalone, moving only along the status track on the Posts board, or individual, with its own stages on the Workflows board.
tracks.noFluxo: A post can also exist without a workflow (standalone post): it moves only along the status track, on the Posts board.
